  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The override that turns `noise` or `environmental` into `pipeline_blocked` does not check `group.get("from_self_workflow")`.
  WHY: An alert from a pipeline workflow that the model calls `noise` or `environmental` is marked `done`, so the pipeline problem skips the self-fix mechanism and the Telegram escalation. The source severity was MAJOR, mapped here to high.

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The host, not the model, decides `pipeline_blocked`. A group is `pipeline_blocked` when: `files` intersects `pipeline_self_files`, or the alert came from one of those workflows, or an `ai:alert-triage` heal issue for the same fingerprint has been open longer than `ALERT_TRIAGE_HEAL_STALL_HOURS` (default 6)."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/alert_triage.py`, `decide_group()` around lines 683-694 / 691-699 (the `elif classification in ("noise", "environmental")` override branch)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The `noise`/`environmental` override in decide_group() checks only `files_blocked` and `stalled` and never `group.get("from_self_workflow")`, while the `healable`/`pipeline_blocked` path re-checks all three conditions. In `tests/test_alert_triage.py:256,260`, the `test_decide_rows` rows `("noise", {"from_self_workflow": True}, [], ("noise", "done", "noise"))` and `("environmental", {"from_self_workflow": True}, [], ("environmental", "done", "environmental"))` lock in the asymmetric behaviour. The `agents.d/alert-triage-phase2-hourly-triage.md` fragment and a code comment document it as deliberate ("a mapped pipeline workflow alone does not"). glm adds that this was justified because `pipeline_self_files` includes `review_autofix.yml`, which nearly every consumer's "AI Review" wrapper maps to. The residual risk is that a pipeline-origin alert wrongly called noise/environmental and naming no pipeline file is marked done.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- NOTE: The reviewer deliberately did not re-raise the `from_self_workflow` gap for `noise`/`environmental`. The plan at `docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md` lines 308-318 lists the workflow-origin criterion, but line 324 routes `noise`/`environmental` to a `done` marker and line 332 keeps single-repo `environmental` on `done`. The previous editor round accepted the deviation, and the code comment, `agents.d` fragment and tests document it. Fleet-wide `fleet_environmental` is Phase 6 and out of scope. The failed checks stop at `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh` with `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF ... outcome=stale reason=not_refreshed`, which is not a defect in the PR. `tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py::test_instructions_point_at_fragments` cannot be caused by this PR.
- HARDENING: scripts/alert_triage.py `decide_group()` (the new `noise`/`environmental` stalled override), together with `apply()` (ledger write)
  PROBLEM: A stalled group the model calls `noise` now becomes `pipeline_blocked`. With `ALERT_TRIAGE_SELF_FIX_ENABLED=false` (the default) it escalates with reason `self_fix_disabled` on every hourly run, because the ledger cap counts only dispatch attempts and escalations have no limit.
  WHY: Suggested fix: in `apply()`, write `last_escalated_at` when `route == "escalate"`. In `decide()`, skip the Telegram entry for reason `self_fix_disabled` when that timestamp is less than `ALERT_TRIAGE_HEAL_STALL_HOURS` old (about 8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.

- HARDENING: scripts/alert_triage.py decide_group() / apply(), the escalate path for overridden `pipeline_blocked` groups (reason self_fix_disabled / self_fix_missing)
  PROBLEM: The per-fingerprint ledger records only dispatch attempts, not group escalations. With ALERT_TRIAGE_SELF_FIX_ENABLED=false (the default), a fingerprint that keeps firing re-runs the model and sends one Telegram escalation every hourly run.
  WHY: Suggested fix: in apply(), append an escalation entry to the ledger's `attempts` (or a parallel list). In decide(), skip the Telegram escalation when the last such entry is younger than ALERT_TRIAGE_HEAL_STALL_HOURS (about 8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1. This applies only once `ALERT_TRIAGE_ENABLED` (default false) is enabled.
